patches.name: title-skip-login-select
patches.description: TitleScene.SetStateSelectLogin(this, toggleIndex) branches straight to SetStateGuestLogin(this), so the login-method popup never shows.

patches.name: skip-terms
patches.description: TitleScene.SetStateTermsAndPolicy() branches to SetStateLoading(), which is what it does when terms were already accepted: no terms/privacy screen.

patches.name: account-always-exists
patches.description: LoginControl.get_AccountCode: PlayerPrefs.GetString(key, "") gets the key itself as default instead of "" (was ldr x1, [x21]). A fresh install therefore has a non-empty account code and the title screen goes straight to auto-login.

patches.name: login-always-available
patches.description: LoginControl.get_IsLoginAvailable returns true, so the title screen treats the account as usable on a fresh install.

patches.name: grant-all-permissions
patches.description: NetworkControl.CheckPermission(permission, callback) invokes the callback right away (if not null): the game never asks for phone/storage/media permissions.

patches.name: skip-download-confirm
patches.description: AssetControl.OnDownloadConfirm: instead of ViewControl.OpenLocalePopup(53, message, callback), invoke the callback (in x20) with isOk=true, so the 'N MB of resources will be downloaded' confirmation never shows.

patches.name: skip-tutorial-proceed-dialog
patches.description: TutorialAssist.OpenAccountConfirmPopup: the end-of-tutorial 'Do you wish to proceed? (Reset / Proceed)' dialog is skipped by calling its callback <OpenAccountConfirmPopup>b__10_0(this, isOk=true).

patches.name: skip-attendance-popup
patches.description: AttendanceAssist.OpenAttendancePopup(this, isChanged) branches to AttendanceAssist.Complete(this, isChanged): the daily attendance popup is skipped.

patches.name: no-dalcom-account-event
patches.description: LobbyScene.SetDalcomAccountEvent() branches to SetStateUpdateNotice(), its next step: the Dalcom account promo popup in the lobby never shows.

patches.name: skip-song-download-confirm
patches.description: InstallMusicAssist.OpenDownloadConfirmPopup(this, md, fileSize) branches to OpenInstallMusicPopup(this, md), what its Download button does: songs download without asking.

patches.name: no-login-queue
patches.description: TitleScene.RequestSequentialLogin(callback) invokes the callback right away: no login queue check at ssg-login.dalcomsoft.net (the host is gone; the game waited forever).
patches.asm: cbz x1, 0x14A3A2C; ldr x0, [x1, #64]; ldr x2, [x1, #24]; ldr x1, [x1, #40]; br x2; ret

patches.name: no-login-queue-leave
patches.description: LoginControl.SequentialLoginCancel() (called when the app is suspended) returns immediately instead of telling ssg-login.dalcomsoft.net that we left the queue.

patches.name: lobby-skip-ad-info
patches.description: LobbyScene.<SetStateAdInfo>b__20_0 (reply to Promotion.getAdminInfo): right after LoadingIndicator.Complete, continue with SetStateTakeHeadphone instead of setting up the ad timer, ad button and message mark (which threw offline and left the lobby empty).

patches.name: store-hide-tab-helper
patches.description: Helper (in the dead body of TitleScene.SetStateSelectLogin): hides a StorePopup.Menu's tab button, i.e. the parent of its first state image (stateObjs[0]). Used by store-hide-tabs.
patches.asm: stp x30, x19, [sp, #-16]!; ldr x8, [x0, #16]; cbz x8, 0x14a4520; ldr w9, [x8, #24]; cbz w9, 0x14a4520; ldr x0, [x8, #32]; cbz x0, 0x14a4520; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x2786c04; cbz x0, 0x14a4520; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x278e63c; cbz x0, 0x14a4520; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x27844a4; cbz x0, 0x14a4520; mov w1, wzr; mov x2, xzr; ldp x30, x19, [sp], #16; b 0x2786cc0; ldp x30, x19, [sp], #16; ret

patches.name: store-remap-helper
patches.description: Helper for store-open-card-packs: every store type except RhythmPoint (3) becomes CardPack (5), then continues in StorePopup.SetState.
patches.asm: cmp w1, #3; mov w9, #5; csel w1, w1, w9, eq; mov w19, w1; b 0x135B0B8

patches.name: store-open-card-packs
patches.description: StorePopup.SetState(type): the hidden tabs (recommended, diamonds, headphones, inventory) open the card packs instead, e.g. when the game sends the player to the diamond shop.

patches.name: store-hide-tab-0
patches.description: StorePopup.OnBuild: menu 0 (Recommend) is hidden instead of getting its title. Real-money offers, headphones (unlimited offline) and inventory slots (set by the server) aren't needed.

patches.name: store-hide-tab-1
patches.description: StorePopup.OnBuild: menu 1 (Diamond) is hidden instead of getting its title. Real-money offers, headphones (unlimited offline) and inventory slots (set by the server) aren't needed.

patches.name: store-hide-tab-4
patches.description: StorePopup.OnBuild: menu 4 (Headphone) is hidden instead of getting its title. Real-money offers, headphones (unlimited offline) and inventory slots (set by the server) aren't needed.

patches.name: store-hide-tab-6
patches.description: StorePopup.OnBuild: menu 6 (InvenExpand) is hidden instead of getting its title. Real-money offers, headphones (unlimited offline) and inventory slots (set by the server) aren't needed.

patches.name: store-hide-popup-shop-helper
patches.description: Helper for store-hide-popup-shop: deactivates the parent of StorePopup.popupStoreText (the Pop-up Shop button).
patches.asm: stp x30, x9, [sp, #-16]!; ldr x0, [x19, #576]; cbz x0, 0x14a4580; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x2784468; cbz x0, 0x14a4580; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x278e63c; cbz x0, 0x14a4580; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x27844a4; cbz x0, 0x14a4580; mov w1, wzr; mov x2, xzr; bl 0x2786cc0; nop; nop; ldp x30, x9, [sp], #16; ret

patches.name: store-hide-popup-shop
patches.description: StorePopup.OnBuild: instead of setting the Pop-up Shop button's label, hide the button (the pop-up shop only had real-money offers).

patches.name: hide-left-menu
patches.description: LobbyView.InitMenus: always take the 'left menu closed' branch (the menu with Mission starts slid out of view), and fetch leftArrowOff.parent.gameObject (the arrow button's frame) instead of leftArrowOff.gameObject, so hide-left-menu-arrow hides the whole button. The left menu only has missions, which are empty offline.
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x19, #256]; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x278e63c; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x27844a4; b 0x1378038

patches.name: hide-left-menu-arrow
patches.description: Second half of hide-left-menu: in the 'closed' branch of LobbyView.InitMenus, SetActive(false) instead of true for the left arrow button (its frame).

patches.name: hide-message-button-helper
patches.description: Helper for hide-message-button: deactivates the parent of LobbyView.messageNewMark[0] (the Message button in the right menu).
patches.asm: stp x30, x19, [sp, #-16]!; ldr x8, [x0, #208]; cbz x8, 0x14a45d4; ldr w9, [x8, #24]; cbz w9, 0x14a45d4; ldr x0, [x8, #32]; cbz x0, 0x14a45d4; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x2784468; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x278e63c; cbz x0, 0x14a45d4; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x27844a4; cbz x0, 0x14a45d4; mov w1, wzr; mov x2, xzr; ldp x30, x19, [sp], #16; b 0x2786cc0; ldp x30, x19, [sp], #16; ret

patches.name: hide-message-button
patches.description: LobbyView.SetMessageNewMark(isShow), which LobbyScene.OnUpdate keeps calling: hide the Message button instead of toggling its 'new' badge. The message box has no content offline (and waited forever for it).

patches.name: hide-message-button-always
patches.description: LobbyScene.OnUpdate: check the message mark on every update, not only when there are new messages, so hide-message-button runs.

patches.name: hide-message-button-state
patches.description: LobbyView.GetMessageMarkState returns false, so LobbyScene.OnUpdate calls SetMessageNewMark (hide-message-button) every time.

patches.name: default-language-helper
patches.description: Helper for default-language-from-device: LanguageConvert.ConvertLanguage(Application.systemLanguage), i.e. the device language, English for languages the game doesn't have.
patches.asm: stp x30, x19, [sp, #-16]!; mov x0, xzr; bl 0x2761304; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x1651E74; ldp x30, x19, [sp], #16; ret

patches.name: default-language-from-device
patches.description: LocaleControl.get_LanguageCode: PlayerPrefs 'language' defaults to the device language instead of the build language (Korean). The original game set it from the device in TitleScene.SetStateSelectLanguage, which our auto-login skips; a language chosen in the settings is still kept.

patches.name: hide-parent-helper
patches.description: Helper (in the dead body of InstallMusicAssist.OpenDownloadConfirmPopup): x0 = a component; deactivates its parent GameObject. Used by hide-menu-attendance and hide-menu-notice.
patches.asm: stp x30, x19, [sp, #-16]!; cbz x0, 0x1403a6c; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x2784468; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x278e63c; cbz x0, 0x1403a6c; mov x1, xzr; bl 0x27844a4; cbz x0, 0x1403a6c; mov w1, wzr; mov x2, xzr; ldp x30, x19, [sp], #16; b 0x2786cc0; ldp x30, x19, [sp], #16; ret

patches.name: hide-menu-attendance
patches.description: TopView.SetMoreButton: instead of setting the Attendance label, hide the Attendance button in the ☰ menu (attendance is skipped offline, the button did nothing).
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x20, #280]; bl 0x1403a34; nop; nop; nop; nop; nop

patches.name: hide-menu-notice
patches.description: TopView.SetMoreButton: instead of setting the Notice label, hide the Notice button in the ☰ menu (there are no notices offline, the button did nothing).
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x20, #288]; bl 0x1403a34; nop; nop; nop; nop; nop

patches.name: no-restart-after-background
patches.description: SystemControl.CheckRestart() returns false: resuming the app after a long time in the background no longer restarts the game at the title screen (it compared the time since the pause with a limit; the only caller is SystemControl.AppResume). Offline there is no session to refresh.

patches.name: download-50-at-a-time-1
patches.description: WWWFile..cctor: LoadSlotCapacity (how many files the client downloads at the same time) is 50, as in SSOMG's newer engine, instead of 4. The first-launch download of thousands of small files from the local server was limited by this. LoadSlotCounter (next field) stays 0 as statics start zeroed.
patches.asm: mov w11, #50 (was: ldr d0, [x9, #696], the shared constant {4, 0})

patches.name: download-50-at-a-time-2
patches.description: WWWFile..cctor: LoadSlotCapacity (how many files the client downloads at the same time) is 50, as in SSOMG's newer engine, instead of 4. The first-launch download of thousands of small files from the local server was limited by this. LoadSlotCounter (next field) stays 0 as statics start zeroed.

patches.name: hide-dalcom-id-banner
patches.description: InfoPopup.OnRefresh (My Info, info tab): the 'Dalcom ID / Register' banner (joinDalcomAccount) is always hidden. There are no accounts offline.
patches.asm: mov w1, wzr (was: mov x2, xzr; x2 is SetActive's unused MethodInfo)

patches.name: hide-account-view
patches.description: InfoAccountView.Refresh (the account box in My Info: guest notice, Delete account, Operation policy, Sign in, Clear data) deactivates its own GameObject instead of filling it in. There are no accounts offline.
